scope: Local isolated populated-upgrade validation and API PostgreSQL session correction. No staging or production deployment; no production-data copy or historical timestamp mutation.

implementation.rootCause: Installed @prisma/adapter-pg 7.8.0 serializes UTC clock text without an offset and normalizes returned timestamptz by replacing its offset with +00:00. With a non-UTC database session, the stored instant can shift while the ORM readback appears correct. AssessmentRuntime.leaseExpiresAt is already TIMESTAMPTZ(3); the SQL live-lease comparison is not the cause.

sourceEvidence.behavior: Parsed URL configuration overrides PoolConfig, then PGOPTIONS supplies only an absent/falsy options value.

implementation.fix: Resolve existing startup options using the driver's URL-over-PGOPTIONS precedence, append -c timezone=UTC, and embed enforced options in the URL plus fallback PoolConfig. Preserve credentials and unrelated options. Do not alter PostgreSQL server/role/database defaults or weaken the lease/checkpoint guard.
implementation.historicalData: No automatic repair of timestamps previously written under a non-UTC Prisma session was attempted.
